_note: SEO roadmap item 3 (26/10/2026): missing exam/topic clusters, PLAN ONLY (no posts written). Weekly writing run reads plan/gsc-priority.json first, then 2026-11-seo-program.json progress.remaining.priority1_localise, then this file's nextBatches. Same field rules as 2026-11-seo-program.json; native rewrite per market (content/blog/prompts/5-localize.md), never machine translation.

method.data: No GSC data yet (seo-gsc first run had 0 items). Demand = public market logic: which exams/intents each market actually searches (DET: hi zh ar vi id tr pt es; Cambridge: es pt fr de tr ru + KET/PET kids in zh vi; PTE: hi zh vi ar id; TOEIC S&W: ko ja vi th zh; kids/parents: ko zh ja vi id th; IT: vi ja ko zh hi id ru; healthcare: hi ar id es pt tr; hospitality: vi th id tr es ar). Competition: non-English SERPs for exam-task and industry intents are thin (forums/YouTube), so priority 1 = high demand × thin SERP × strong app feature. Re-rank by GSC impressions once seo-gsc reports items.
method.dedupe: Checked against all 569 posts (translationKey + keyword per language) and 556 existing briefs on 26/10/2026. Existing business posts (email, meeting, presentation, interview, CV, small talk) and traveller-phrase posts are NOT re-planned: this file only adds uncovered intents and lists the old posts in otherKeys to link. relative-clauses / reported-speech / make-vs-do reuse the existing translationKeys so hreflang joins.
rules: One primary keyword per post per language; langTargets only lists languages without a post on that translationKey.
otherKeys = nearby existing posts: link to them, never write a 2nd post on their keyword; where it says 'enrich', add a section to the old post instead.
origin = language to write first (en unless the market is native-first, e.g. ko for TOEIC Speaking, vi for kids/IT/hospitality). Any later language localises from the first written version.

category must be a CATEGORIES key (scripts/lib/blog-content.mjs). DET/Cambridge/PTE/business/industry use 'ky-nang', kids 'phuong-phap'; examTag + tags carry the exam/cluster. A dedicated 'other exams' category needs owner OK + 15-lang i18n (follow-up).

links.tools: 'test' = /<lang>/<toolPath test>/, 'test/b2' = level page, 'toeic' = TOEIC Part 5 quiz; resolve with toolPath() in scripts/lib/tools-links.mjs (PR #67). links.dict: words to link on dictionary pages (/vi/tu-dien/<w>/, /en/dictionary/<w>/ – vi/en only while dict stage is S1; skip for other languages).
Kids cluster: content is for parents/adult learners; never present the app as a children's app (store + privacy rules).
Healthcare: OET is mentioned for comparison only; no medical advice.
Schedule: blog-schedule --from >=36 h ahead, ≤1 post/lang/day, same cluster ≥7 days apart. Gates: blog-check, blog-dupes, blog-schedule --verify, test/blog-images, test/blog-captions, npm test.
method.fields: Same as 2026-11-seo-program.json plus: role pillar|satellite, origin, links {tools, dict}, examTag (exam/industry label kept for tags).

clusters.name: Duolingo English Test (DET)
clusters.why: Cheap online exam accepted by many US/UK/AU universities; demand strongest in India, China, Gulf/Egypt, Vietnam, Indonesia, Brazil/LatAm, Turkey. Low competition in non-English SERPs (mostly forums/YouTube).

clusters.name: Cambridge B1 Preliminary / B2 First / C1 Advanced
clusters.why: Main school/job certificates in Spain, Portugal, Italy-style markets, also France, Germany, Turkey, Russia; KET/PET huge for children in China and Vietnam. Each level is its own head term, so one pillar per family + level satellites.

clusters.name: PTE Academic
clusters.why: Computer-scored exam for Australia/NZ migration and study; huge in India, strong in China, Vietnam (Úc), Gulf/Pakistan-adjacent Arabic, Nepal/Philippines via English. Exam-format queries are very specific (task names), low competition in local languages.

clusters.name: TOEIC Speaking & Writing
clusters.why: Required by employers/universities in Korea (토익스피킹 is a top exam term), Japan (TOEIC SW), Vietnam (TOEIC 4 kỹ năng), Taiwan/China, Thailand, France. App has a dedicated #/toeic-sw module — strongest feature fit in this plan.

clusters.name: Business English (new angles only)
clusters.why: Email, meeting, presentation, interview, CV and small talk already exist in most languages: this cluster adds a hub plus the UNCOVERED intents (phone calls, negotiation, chat/Slack, vocabulary, polite softening, salary talk). Roleplay for Work (#/roleplay) is the feature.

clusters.name: English for kids & parents
clusters.why: Parents search in their own language for home methods, not for "English grammar". Very strong in Korea (엄마표 영어), China (少儿英语/启蒙), Vietnam, Japan (おうち英語), Indonesia, Thailand, Turkey, Arabic Gulf, Brazil/Spain. Adult-app angle: parent learns alongside; never claim the app is made for children (store/privacy rules).

clusters.name: English for IT & software
clusters.why: Developers in Vietnam, Japan (エンジニア 英語), Korea, China, India, Indonesia, Russia, Turkey, Brazil search for job-focused English. Roleplay has a "dev-interview" scenario.

clusters.name: English for healthcare (medical & nursing)
clusters.why: Nurses/doctors working abroad: India, Philippines-style English searches, Arabic Gulf, Indonesia, Thailand, Brazil, Spain, Turkey. OET is the healthcare-specific exam (link, never claim app prepares OET fully).

clusters.name: English for tourism & hospitality (staff side)
clusters.why: Hotel/restaurant/tour staff in Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia (Bali), Turkey, Spain, Gulf, India, Brazil, China. Traveller-phrase posts already exist (ar hi id ja ru th tr): this cluster is the WORKER intent, link to traveller posts only.

clusters.name: Grammar gaps: relative clauses, reported speech, make/do (vi first + markets still missing)
clusters.why: The 3 vi gaps already sit in 2026-11-seo-program.json progress.remaining.priority1_localise under the SAME translationKeys: write them from there (do not create new keys). This cluster adds the other languages still missing these topics plus 3 deeper vi satellites that do not cannibalise the pillar keywords.
